name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.143.0 — A repo's test count is now instrumented, not capped. `lib/scan-test-calls.js` is the one definition of a test case — a `test(`/`it(` call at line start across the host's test-classified files, blind to strings, comments and regex literals — and `count-tests.js` reports it (`tests: <count> cases`, `--json` → `{"count":N}`, never a non-zero exit for the count itself). The review's new `tests` leg records that count on every evidence manifest and is deliberately absent from every blocking set (`BLOCKING`, `REVIEW_BLOCKING`, `BLOCKING_LEGS`), so the number lands on each ledger row and can never redden a verdict. There is no limit, no ceiling file and no hook: `spec/test-ceiling.json` is deleted, and a count that could fail a build would make deleting tests the model's cheapest route to green. 7.142.0 — specs/20260910/05: exclusion rows are derived, never hand-typed — ledger derive turns discovery non-goals, no-answered invented rows, and not-needed note withdrawals into exclusion rows; the client confirms them one button each on a journey's last screen before --mark approved will run; --mark roadmap-written refuses any confirmed exclusion missing from the roadmap overview's Parking lot; and --mark approved writes design/mocks/exclusions.md, a dated file a statement of work can cite. 7.141.0 — The escape command's prevention-note step no longer prescribes the escape row's own id as a Gotchas entry's owner citation. That id embeds a timestamp, and the same sentence bans dates in exactly that section, so every entry written to the old instruction was classed as date narration and reddened the repo-wide narration scan. The step now prescribes the spec path the defect escaped plus the spec that fixes it, and says outright that the row id is never the citation.
